interpretation_boundary: All 20 previously seen texts, including four with known FP32 pilot results. Engineering sensitivity only, not population equivalence, independent prompt replication, or semantic control.

primary.aggregation: Existing seed-matched signed estimator; equal mean of all four early bin coefficients within each prompt.
primary.coverage_rule: All four early bins must be finite for each of all 20 prompts in every arm. No imputation or reduced-prompt primary claim.
primary.stability_rule: Every prompt early coefficient must remain positive in all three arms; BOTH native-FP32 arms must differ from FP16 replay by at most 0.05 absolute for every prompt. Otherwise retain PRECISION_SENSITIVE_ON_FULL_SUITE or INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE and the individual failures.
primary.tolerance_interpretation: Prespecified engineering sensitivity bound, not statistical or population equivalence. Always report actual deltas and separate fixed-field from rebuilt-field changes.
primary.response_support_rule: Separate from precision sensitivity: reuse the prior L7 early response endpoint, complete 80-bin coverage and positive lower bound of a two-sided 95% percentile prompt-bootstrap interval, 5000 draws, seed1729. This cannot override a failed precision decision.
